CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Careers in Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Careers in Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Careers in Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Damage equipment used for Careers in Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Practise Careers in Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

   D. Damage equipment used for Rugby.

9. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Red, blue, and yellow
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Green, orange, and purple

10. Best practice when working on Swimming 10 2.12.2 Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts : (1 mark)

----
